name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
summary: Balancing on one leg, hinge forward as the other leg lifts behind, then return.
setup: Stand side-on to the phone on the working leg, knee soft. Hinge at the hip, reaching the free leg straight back and the hands toward the floor, until the body is near level. Return to standing.
brief: Stand on the working leg, knee soft. Hinge at the hip, reaching the free leg straight back and the hands toward the floor, until the body is near level.
why: From the side the trunk hinges toward horizontal every rep, so reps are counted. Hip rotation — the main fault — is a front-view detail.
progression: Hold a weight; slow the lowering.
regression: Fingertips on a wall; smaller hinge.
contraindications: Balance problems without support; hamstring strain.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Hip opening to the side
faults.tip: Point the free toes at the floor so the pelvis stays level.

faults.label: Back rounding
faults.tip: Reach the head forward and the heel back; stop before the back rounds.

faults.label: Rushing to stay balanced
faults.tip: Speed hides poor balance. Three seconds down is the standard.

guide.surface: Flat floor; a wall in reach.

points.t: Reaches back in line with the trunk; toes down.
